entry.title: Economic Development Committee: the meeting of 16 November 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Committee moved to oppose a separate stormwater utility and to ask the state delegation to help with a liquor license. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q9t-hcVSgGo), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
